opening.argument: The displayed pay plan offers three paid mining pool options priced at $500, $1,000, and $2,000, while the speaker says a pool share provides a share of Bitcoin mined. The plan also directs that 50% of mined Bitcoin can be withdrawn and the other 50% goes back into repurchases, tying continued participation to equipment purchases. Income is further linked to sponsoring participants and their purchases, including stated commissions and residual income from a downline. The speaker claims payments will continue for years and says a later ClubCoin allocation will be less. These claimed mining outputs, coin availability, commissions, and payment outcomes remain unverified.
